## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] Schema changes are in a new `db/migrations/NNN_*.sql` file
- [ ] New data comes only from lawfully public sources, with `source_url` provenance
- [ ] No personal contact details added to public data; private network data stays private
- [ ] SEC requests go through `SecClient` (≤ 10 req/s)
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this and agree it is licensed under MIT (code) / ODbL (data), per [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
